prompt: Find the paper attachment for the appointments workshop and put it on my reading list

assertions.name: searches_email_first
assertions.description: Agent searches email (superhuman) before trying web/SSRN/scholar

assertions.name: extracts_metadata
assertions.description: Agent uses look-at to extract title/authors/date from the PDF

assertions.name: proposes_filename_format
assertions.description: Proposed filename follows Author (Date) - Title.pdf convention

assertions.name: daily_note_under_reading
assertions.description: Daily note entry is inserted under # Reading heading, not appended to end
